actions.label: Shopping list
actions.description: See what's on your shopping list.
actions.agent: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.

show.label: Show
show.description: Which items to list; all of them when left out.

actions.label: Add to list
actions.description: Add an item to your shopping list.
actions.agent: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.

name.label: Item
name.description: What to buy, as the person said it, such as "oat milk".

unit.label: Unit
unit.description: The unit of the quantity, such as g, cups or cans.

actions.label: Share list
actions.description: Share your shopping list with someone in your household.
actions.agent: Share the person's shopping list with another person, who can then see and change it.

with.label: With
with.description: The email address of the person to share with.

canEdit.label: Can edit
canEdit.description: Whether they may change the list, not only see it.

actions.label: Place order
actions.description: Order everything on your list and pay for it.
actions.agent: Order the shopping list's items for delivery and pay for them.

personOnly.reason: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can.
personOnly.how: with Place order on the shopping list
